risk_note: RV2 (linking/**; attribution and money). linking open writes and its idempotency record in one transaction through platform executeInTransaction: owner-stage link and claim, requote link, open log and attempt commit with the idempotent response or roll back together; a non-stored result (e.g. 50303) logs once after the rollback with every field from the requested link, no attempt; single-flight shared links inserted per transaction with ON CONFLICT so a rolled-back initiator leaves no dangling link; the first 50303 in the window kept per identity key; config, pids and attr codes read before the transaction so no second pool connection is taken while it holds one; a reused single-flight conversion re-checked against jump.expire_at; the idempotency hash covers the whole validated body. External ports (catalog, price fetch, conversion adapter, conversion cache) still run inside the transaction: their production implementations must not borrow api pool connections, guaranteed by the B1-06w wiring (followups). Written by hand.
